domain_authority: coordinator-distributed broad creative exploration scope, not a requester visual requirement

pool.concept: At a tide-wet harbor ferry vestibule, a lone floral courier steadies a fragile flowering branch crate across the narrow gap from quay to ferry while the gate waits half-open.
Inside a stopped night-mail carriage, a lone attendant releases the last gold-edged botanical keepsake case from a sorting shelf while dawn reaches through the carriage-door seam.
At the upper funicular station after rain, a lone conservator carefully unloads a shallow white-blossom specimen case while cable hardware and mountain mist frame her waiting hands.
At a quiet cargo terminal inspection table, a lone messenger verifies a gold-framed botanical glass crate while its hinged lid holds a reflection of the opening loading-bay light.
On the narrow service platform of an old canal lock, a lone courier pauses with a flowering travel case as a passing barge shifts the water and a mooring line settles taut.
At the final turning loop of an old city tram, a lone flower-delivery traveler stands just inside the tram door, holding a shallow blossom crate as the driverless empty carriage settles at its stop.
At a dim railway luggage lift, a lone delivery attendant lowers a hinged floral display case from a brass-edged trolley to the lift threshold as the lift door admits a slender band of warm light.
